target.rule: Generate an exact target from node.blueprint_id; never infer an item or display name.

domain.rule: Choose an existing enabled domain; preserve cross-domain prerequisite identities.

lane.rule: Choose a declared lane; lane assignment does not create branch ownership.

tier.rule: Retain the legacy tier enum; rank and scoped progression policy retain authority.

level.rule: Retain the legacy integer level 0 through 4; do not use as a workstation tier.

rank.rule: Integer 0 through 1000000; all prerequisites precede the node.

order.rule: Integer 0 through 1000000; controls placement order, not progression.

rating.rule: Retain combat, utility, and appeal integer scores 0 through 100.

tierOverrideReason.rule: Retain trimmed metadata text up to 512 characters.

fallback.rule: Retain fallback provenance; it does not grant research access.

branch.rule: Generate from the single direct branch owner.

members.rule: Generate exact blueprint members; never maintain a second editable membership list.

widthMode.rule: Fixed or dynamic width; preserve the selected runtime enum.

minNodesPerLayer.rule: Integer 8 through 28, no greater than maximum; fixed width requires equality.

maxNodesPerLayer.rule: Integer 8 through 28; a width constraint, not a node or progression limit.

mode.rule: Choose none, dynamic, or configured. Legacy is derived from format-1 trees, never a literal serialized mode.

ranksPerBand.rule: Integer 1 through 64 for dynamic bands; other modes use the default.

basis.rule: Configured rank or score boundary basis; other modes retain rank.

definitions.rule: At most 32 ordered configured definitions; empty outside configured mode.

id.rule: Stable resource ID independent of the displayed label.

title.rule: Trimmed nonempty title up to 80 characters.

translationKey.rule: Optional translation resource key; external translations remain a dependency.

color.rule: Optional RGB integer 0 through 16777215, presented with a color control.

icon.rule: Optional resource ID; the project does not create missing assets.

maximum.rule: Optional ordered inclusive boundary in the chosen rank/score basis; retain the final open band.

points.rule: Whole units of active currency, 0 through 1000000000; inherit the whole cost when absent.

ingredients.rule: At most six predicates; preserve combined allocation and item/tag meaning.

items.rule: At most 64 exact item alternatives; mutually exclusive with tag.

tag.rule: One item tag, mutually exclusive with items; resolved membership is a context dependency.

count.rule: Whole item count 1 through 64, allocated jointly with every other cost.

anyOf.rule: One through 64 distinct blueprint alternatives in a compiled group; groups combine with AND.

config_treatment: Capture raw and effective values plus preset selectors. Read-only assumptions in the tree editor; activation must resolve mismatches explicitly.
